repository.name: HA-Energy-Price-Engine
repository.description: A modular Home Assistant integration that automatically retrieves, calculates and stores complete electricity prices, including spot prices, grid tariffs, supplier fees, taxes and VAT. Provides persistent 15-minute price data for EV charging, heating, battery storage and smart energy automation.

release.name: v0.1.0-beta.8 — quarter-hour price dashboard and applied tariffs
release.body:
Beta.7 standardizes **all preferred price displays to øre/kWh with exactly two decimals**, or optional **DKK/kWh with four**. Current/next and requested future-window readiness are independent from historical whole-day coverage. Stored canonical DKK/kWh, full precision, original entity/statistics units, SQLite and read-only CM APIv1 are preserved.

**HACS prerelease for development Home Assistant acceptance.** Exact source **cbad4e7595e7eba4080aca295bfca521f9b0409a**. Immutable **v0.1.0-beta.8**; existing draft [PR #14](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/pull/14) remains unmerged. Main and beta.1–.7 tags/assets preserved. No stable release or production/control changes.

## Install/update and open the dashboard

1. Back up development HA. HACS → Energy Price Engine → persist **Show beta versions**, refresh, select **v0.1.0-beta.8**, Download. Restart HA and reload browser/app. Device info must show **0.1.0-beta.8**. Keep existing sites/configuration/history.
2. In HA user profile enable Advanced mode. **Settings → Dashboards → three-dot menu → Resources**: add `/ha_energy_price_engine/energy-price-engine-card.js?v=0.1.0-beta.8` as **JavaScript module**. The file is bundled in the integration HACS ZIP; no extra HACS frontend repository, chart plugin or external service.
3. Create/open an empty dashboard → Edit dashboard → Raw configuration editor. Paste the complete YAML below and replace **only the one entity ID** with any sensor of the chosen PE site (e.g. Final now incl. VAT). Save and pin the dashboard in the sidebar. Do not replace an existing dashboard layout unintentionally.

```yaml
title: Energy prices
views:
  - title: Electricity prices
    path: electricity-prices
    icon: mdi:chart-timeline-variant
    type: panel
    cards:
      - type: custom:energy-price-engine-card
        entity: sensor.your_site_final_now_incl_vat
```

[Complete dashboard/resource guide](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.8/docs/PRICE_DASHBOARD.md) · [Pasteable YAML file](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.8/docs/dashboard.yaml) · [HACS setup/repair](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.8/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Owner acceptance](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.8/docs/BETA_ACCEPTANCE.md).

## Changes

- **Two real quarter-hour series for today/tomorrow:** raw official Nord Pool spot excluding VAT/charges, and verified final marginal electricity including DSO, Energinet network/system, supplier per-kWh markup, tax and VAT. Both use **ore/kWh, exactly two decimals**, with shared local-calendar/UTC-continuous axes, Now marker and day boundary. Negative prices preserved; missing/stale/error/unverified final values are gaps, never manufactured zeros.
- **Complete quarter table:** all local intervals plus UTC identities/offsets, spot, DSO, Energinet network/system, supplier, tax, VAT, verified final, status and stored source revision. Select a bar/quarter for source, verification/effective period and full component inspection.92/96/100-slot days and repeated autumn hours handled; tomorrow expands separately. Tables scroll on phones.
- **Today's applied network tariff table:** only today's actual stored DSO rates, adjacent exact equal values merged with matching verification/source. Configured automatic Radius C labelled explicitly. Missing stored intervals remain unavailable; no seasonal/annual catalogue or guessed tariff.
- **Native supported read-only transport/card:** authenticated HA WebSocket command, HA entity read permissions and one loaded site, bounded two local days. No large Recorder states, hundreds of entities, provider calls, SQL connections or tariff recomposition on dashboard reads. Bundled dependency-free custom card uses native static-file registration and Lovelace resource interface; no frontend/HACS monkeypatch or external CDN/library.
- **Transparent readiness:** current/next independent of historical gaps. Independently verified raw spot stays visible when final supplier/tariff components are missing. Missing components, affected period, actionable correction, tomorrow publication guidance and next scheduled check remain visible. Retained stale amounts are labelled in the inspector and never plotted as verified.
- **Cleaner device UI:** one-time integration-owned disabled default for unused estimated/unverified entities on existing sites; defaults disabled on new sites. Identities/history/user hides and disables preserved; later explicit opt-in survives reload. Configured provisional estimates remain labelled and outside verified/API data. Supported lowercase presentation enums display Ready/Incomplete/Stale/Error (localized); original canonical uppercase machine enums remain unchanged for compatibility.
- **Existing engine preserved:** APIv1/coordinator/engine/SQLite/schedule/updater/source normalization/component arithmetic byte-identical to beta.7. Full-precision DKK/kWh CM API, negative prices, Radius transitions, dated national/supplier/VAT rules, historical revisions, settled values and refreshes **13:05,13:20,13:40,23:59,00:01** retained. No subscriptions in marginal costs, private contract/heating guesses or future EWII extrapolation. Historical EWII0.030DKK exVAT applies only June–September2026.

## Validation and integrity

**324 producer tests/core**, HA **2026.10.3/current2026.10.4**, **89% coverage**, zero skips, two unchanged upstream HACS deprecation warnings. Four unchanged CM suites **153/176/227/228/core**, plus two coupled runtime cases/reference/core. **15 browser regressions** generated from real producer/source/SQLite data cover DST, both series/tables/all quarters, negative/zero, missing/unpublished/gaps, revisions, keyboard/mobile, EN/en-GB/DA/custom/browser numeric preferences and XSS. Official hassfest1integration/0invalid, HACS and both native package layouts outside source pass. All19 exact-source push/PR/tag/draft checks must pass before this release is uploaded.

Native disposable **HA2026.10.4/frontend20260930.5**, desktop1440x1000/mobile390x844: both192-point graphs, all192 rows, four merged DSO ranges, source/components/future inspection, unpublished/raw-only/partial/gap/provisional sites, persisted Danish locale, live source revisions and optional device cleanup; zero browser errors/warnings. Provider-call counters unchanged on dashboard reads. Beta.7 upgrade preserved6configs/4ledgers/162original entity IDs. Restart preserves6configs/168IDs/**637price rows/revisions**/**14Recorder unit identities**.636 browser rows matched exact current OR historical SQLite revisions, all component/VAT/final/source values.14 screenshot hashes/source evidence are in the [native simulation receipt](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.8/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.8-simulation.json). Synthetic/recorded data, **not owner real-HA acceptance**.

Two fresh post-publication runner jobs independently download actual public assets, tagged source and compliant main; verify checksums/runtime bytes; exercise pinned actual **HACS2.0.5/upstream** register/discover/beta install/update/uninstall/reinstall plus both native ZIP layouts on both cores. Published beta7 must select8, installed8 remain current, stable exclude prereleases/hashes. The [publication receipt](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/feat/beta5-simple-onboarding/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.8.json) is recorded after both succeed.

## Limits

Resource registration is one supported HA UI step; the card is not injected into HA's device page. Dedicated dashboard covers only today/tomorrow; canonical Python API history remains unchanged. Missing final ledger records cannot prove applied DSO/component values; the raw series may still be independently available. All-in inputs cannot reveal unknown component splits. Exact numeric canonical values/machine statuses intentionally remain technical; do not use rounded dashboard values for CM cost/control. User entity/card precision preferences outside this card remain user-owned.

Actual private supplier/VAT/grid/heating terms, live provider availability and physical mobile/hardware acceptance remain owner checks. Public national baselines have bounded verified periods; other products/future rates need verified rules. New sites may have partial first-day history. HACS external catalog branding can fall back. **Cloud benchmarks do not establish Raspberry Pi performance**; original SQLite improvement remains intact and synchronous API history remains in RAM.

No production HA, Node-RED, Tesla, Easee, CM source or charging commands touched. No main merge/stable release. Stop after beta.8 publication, independent verification and permanent handoff.
